name: xenon-web
description: Xenon Terminal — market structure reconstruction instrument with real-time IB streaming and AI chat.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n next,ib,api -c cyan,yellow,green "XENON_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:${XENON_API_PORT:-8421} next dev -p 3200" "node ../scripts/infra/ib_realtime/ib_realtime_server.js --port 8866" "uv run --project .. uvicorn xenon.api.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${XENON_API_PORT:-8421} --reload --reload-dir ../src --app-dir ../src"
